# TrustedRouter Aims to Give Companies Greater Privacy With AI

The startup offers companies a way to keep employees’ AI use private from model makers

![An artificial intelligence logo.](https://assets.bwbx.io/images/users/iqjWHBFdfxIU/imptvl_CjVZk/v6/-1x-1.webp)

An artificial intelligence logo. Photographer: Krisztian Bocsi/Bloomberg

By Davey Alba

November 26, 2026 at 2:02 PM GMT+2

Welcome to Tech In Depth, our daily newsletter about the business of tech from Bloomberg’s journalists around the world. Today, Davey Alba reports on a startup looking to give companies more privacy in their use of AI.

Corporate espionage: An SAP employee allegedly took confidential information from a British partner company and gave it to a rival. SAP didn’t disclose the incident.
